story.titleZh: 小林智久将替代奥康出战墨西哥城大奖赛剩余赛事
story.summaryZh: 小林智久将替代奥康出战墨西哥城大奖赛剩余赛事，他在周五的FP1中排名第15。

story.originalTitle: TGR Haas F1 Team reserve driver Ryō Hirakawa will replace Esteban Ocon for the remainder of the weekend’s Mexico City Grand Prix. Ryō participated ...
story.summaryEn:
TGR Haas F1 Team reserve driver Ryō Hirakawa will replace Esteban Ocon for the remainder of the weekend’s Mexico City Grand Prix. 
Ryō participated in FP1 at the Autodromo Hermanos Rodriguez on Friday, his third free practice outing of the season driving the VF-26, finishing 15th overall. 
The Japanese driver will partner teammate Ollie Bearman through final practice and qualifying on Saturday and Sunday’s 71-lap grand prix – marking Ryō's Formula 1 race debut.
No further statements will be made at this time.
#HaasF1 #F1 #MexicoGP | @ryohirakawa
detailZh:
TGR 哈斯F1车队预备车手里约·平川将在本周末墨西哥城大奖赛的剩余时间里替换埃斯蒂班·奥康。
里约在周五的阿赫曼诺斯·罗德里格斯赛道参加了第一场自由练习赛，这是他本赛季第三次驾驶VF-26赛车，最终排名第15。
这位日本车手将在周六和周日的71圈大奖赛中与队友奥利·贝尔曼搭档，进行最终练习和排位赛——这标志着里约的F1赛车首秀。
目前不会发表进一步声明。
#哈斯F1 #F1 #墨西哥GP | @ryohirakawa
